free_tier.stated: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month, egress free

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: storage is metered by volume rather than per object

retention.stated: not applicable: bytes persist while the account is in good standing

egress.free_allowance: none for egress: egress to the internet is free on every plan

chaining: the origin that makes a free front free: R2 holds the bytes with zero egress and a Cloudflare front serves them, so the read path costs nothing at any volume and the 10 GB is the whole bill.

limits.value: 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month

reliability_note: zero egress applies to the read path only

evidence.proved: 10 GB-month storage, 1M Class A, 10M Class B, egress free; page last updated 2026-10-01

extras.transit_note: the object leaves Cloudflare's network on every read, and egress is free on every plan

binding_note: nothing binds the egress: it is free unconditionally. The 10 GB-month storage volume caps what an origin can hold and no kind names a volume
limits_note: the 10 GB-month is a storage volume and not an object size, so no kind in the six-value vocabulary names it.
